verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.base44.com/llms.txt. The docs are also served as .md pages, and an official Docs MCP server lets AI assistants search the documentation directly, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: independent community corroboration of agents using the llms.txt/docs MCP in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
